sections.title: Mathematicians' Grief & Capability Gaps / 五阶段哀伤与能力缺口
sections.desc: Amjad（651 赞）：「看数学家们在极短窗口内走完五阶段哀伤——否认、愤怒、讨价还价、抑郁、接受；我们已到抑郁尾声、正在进入接受」；Rauchg（341 赞）：「TypeScript is the new TypeScript 😂——scriptc 编译后比 tsgo 快 2-4 倍」；Levie（125 赞）：「AI 训练模型将比人类更好已到实用阈值，难以置信」；Shipper（86 赞）：「generation 已经又便宜又好——下一个大的能力跃升是 editing and oversight」；Turck 的算力梗（81 赞）。

cards.authorTag: Replit CEO / Vercel CEO / Box CEO / Every CEO / FirstMark

rewrite: Amjad's observation (651): 'Fascinating to see Mathematicians go through all the stages of grief — Denial, Anger, Bargaining, Depression, and Acceptance — in such a compressed window of time. We're at the tail end of depression and entering acceptance.' Rauchg's compiler joke (341): 'TypeScript is the new TypeScript 😂 When 𝚜𝚌𝚛𝚒𝚙𝚝𝚌-compiled, outperforms tsgo by 2-4x.' Shipper's capability map (86): 'generation is now cheap and high quality — the big capabilities bump we need is now editing and oversight.' And Turck's meme (81): 'When an AI startup gets a compute allocation.'

original: Diogo Almeida: I would describe RLHF as making models chat and making models pleasing for chat.
Diogo Almeida: AI is very strong at system one… we have not come even close to solving the jaggedness of system two.
Diogo Almeida: The way I like to describe it is 95% Einstein, 5% Mr. Bean. And if it doesn't tell you when it's the Mr. Bean, then how are you gonna automate anything?
Diogo Almeida: I think pretraining is a giant dumpster fire of wasting resources.
Diogo Almeida: We're building prod, not god.
Diogo Almeida: The way AI winter I'm worried about is AI continuing to be so unbelievably useless at automation. And I just think that that's not gonna happen anymore.

original: 【金句回顾】
「一句话：RLHF 是让模型会聊天、让模型讨人喜欢。」
「AI 在系统一上非常强……而我们远未解决系统二的参差性。」
「我喜欢这么形容：95% 爱因斯坦、5% 憨豆先生。它不告诉你什么时候是憨豆，你怎么敢自动化任何东西？」
